name: Content Pipeline
description: Research a topic, draft an article, review it, then publish — a linear 4-stage fan-through that shows dependsOn wiring.

steps.title: Research: {{topic}}
steps.description: Research the topic "{{topic}}". Produce 5-8 key findings with sources, the current state of the art, and 3 angles worth writing about. Output as markdown.
acceptance: research.md is saved in the artifacts dir with 5-8 numbered findings
Every finding has a source URL
Exactly 3 writing angles are proposed, each one sentence

steps.title: Draft an article on {{topic}}
steps.description: Using the research provided, write a 600-900 word article on "{{topic}}". Clear structure, engaging intro, concrete takeaways. Output the full article as markdown.
acceptance: article.md is saved in the artifacts dir with 600-900 words
It has a title, an intro, at least 3 section headings and a takeaways section
Claims trace to findings in the research result (no new uncited statistics)

steps.title: Review the {{topic}} draft
steps.description: Review the drafted article for accuracy, clarity, and tone. List concrete edits, then output the corrected final article.
acceptance: The result lists the concrete edits made (at least 3, or states why fewer were needed)
final-article.md is saved in the artifacts dir and stays within 600-900 words
Every factual claim in final-article.md is consistent with the research findings
verify: diff article.md final-article.md from the two tasks' artifact dirs shows the listed edits

steps.title: Prepare {{topic}} for publishing
steps.description: Take the reviewed final article and prepare it for publishing: write an SEO title, meta description, 5 tags, and a 2-sentence social blurb. Output everything as markdown.
acceptance: publish.md is saved in the artifacts dir with: SEO title (<= 60 chars), meta description (<= 160 chars), exactly 5 tags, a 2-sentence social blurb
The SEO title and meta description contain the topic keyword
verify: check title length <= 60 and meta description length <= 160 characters
